checks.command: Inspection: CodeMirrorHost EditorView.updateListener -> ChangeSet incremental document reconstruction -> CodeWorkspaceTab onChange/shared WorkspaceDocumentTransactionOwner -> controlled echo/rejected transaction recovery; native collector reads taomniDocumentSnapshot
checks.summary: The real editor entry remains CodeMirrorHost. Character-level updates reuse the immediately previous controlled snapshot and ChangeSet, while a broken state chain falls back to CodeMirror's full document. The resulting deltas still enter the shared document owner and onChange path; delayed controlled echoes acknowledge only current owner text, rejected edits restore the canonical owner snapshot, and the existing selection, shared undo, save, stale-owner and failure paths remain authoritative. The native collector observes keydown and DOM mutation without injecting editor state and reads a read-only full-document snapshot only for the postcondition.
